description: Share purchase agreement between a German seller and a Dutch buyer. German tax ID, tax number, VAT ID, ID card number, address and licence plate; EU VAT numbers (DE, NL, FR, BE); IBANs from several countries; German and Dutch phone formats; register numbers (optional) and EU regulation numbers as traps.

SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

dated 12 June 2025

between

(1) Dr. Henrike Vollmer-Baumgart, born on 17 February 1971, residing at Lindenallee 42, 10719 Berlin, Germany, holder of German identity card no. L01X00T47, tax identification number (Steuer-ID) 12 345 678 903 (the "Seller");

and

(2) Zeeland Marine Technologies B.V., a private limited company incorporated under Dutch law, registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce under number 71849302, VAT number NL859632147B01, with registered office at Westerdok 118, 1013 BH Amsterdam, the Netherlands (the "Purchaser"),

concerning all shares in

Vollmer Antriebstechnik GmbH, registered with the commercial register of the Local Court (Amtsgericht) of Charlottenburg under HRB 184467 B, tax number 27/614/04418, VAT ID DE298417365 (the "Company").

1. SALE AND PURCHASE

1.1 The Seller sells to the Purchaser, and the Purchaser purchases, the shares with a nominal amount of EUR 25,000 (the "Sold Shares"), representing 100% of the share capital.

1.2 The purchase price is EUR 4,750,000.00 (the "Purchase Price"), of which EUR 500,000.00 shall be paid into escrow with Notar Dr. Felix Brandauer, notary in Berlin.

2. PAYMENT

2.1 The Purchase Price shall be paid to the Seller's account, IBAN DE44 5001 0517 5407 3249 31, BIC INGDDEFFXXX.

2.2 Any refund to the Purchaser shall be paid to IBAN NL91ABNA0417164300. Payments by the Purchaser's French affiliate, Zeeland Marine France SAS (VAT FR61123456789), shall come from IBAN FR14 2004 1010 0505 0001 3M02 606; payments by its Belgian affiliate (VAT BE0123456749) from IBAN BE68 5390 0754 7034.

3. COMPANY CAR

3.1 The Seller may keep the company car, a Mercedes-Benz E 300 with registration number B-HV 4471, at its book value of EUR 18,200.

4. REPRESENTATIONS

4.1 The Seller represents that the Company complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) and Directive (EU) 2019/1937, and that no proceedings are pending before the Regional Court (Landgericht) of Berlin, except case 16 O 248/24.

5. NOTICES

Seller: Henrike Vollmer-Baumgart, h.vollmer@vollmer-antrieb.example.de, +49 30 901820 44, mobile +49 151 2345 6789
Purchaser: Zeeland Marine Technologies B.V., attn. Joost van der Linde, j.vanderlinde@zeeland-marine.example.nl, +31 20 794 1180

6. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement is governed by German law. Place of jurisdiction is Berlin.

Berlin, 12 June 2025

_______________________          _______________________
Henrike Vollmer-Baumgart          for Zeeland Marine Technologies B.V.
